subject: #1218 fix-needed: a missing or stale Mac run reads green; stale-cover advice clears a live hand
body: Adversarial review of #1218 at c762ea87 (own worktree; self-test 73/73; --coherence, --check, check-raised-hands, action pinning and parity all green; every detector mutant caught). Two MEDIUMs block the landing. (1) scripts/raised-hands.mjs:211,327-329,338: latestDecisiveRun never checks age and raises nothing when there is no decisive run. A 60-day-old success, zero completed runs, and a per_page=10 window that is all cancelled each give 0 hands, so an unknown state reads green (golden rule 2), and nothing else watches mac-lane.yml. Fix: raise mac-lane-red:no-recent-run when the run is null or older than about 8 days. (2) scripts/raised-hands.mjs:228: the stale-cover line says 'no longer stuck, clear that hand' for kinds not evaluated this run. That covers objective-owner whenever the state is unwitnessed (it prints that today, because the tick heartbeat is 6.4h old) and mac-lane-red on every run without --github. Clearing on that advice makes the gate fail once the tick resumes (objective-owner past its 144h limit today). Fix: skip the stale-cover report for any kind not evaluated this run. NITs: a green sim_only dispatch masks a red weekly run (add &event=schedule to the query); the 3h mac-lane-red limit is never enforced, because --check never runs with --github. Push the two fixes and send a land ask; the cloud re-reviews the delta and merges on green.
